hints.lines: Each print() makes its own line. You should have exactly two lines.
hints.other: The second line is a sum. Python multiplies before it adds.

hints.error: Text needs speech marks around it, at the start and at the end.
hints.capitals: Check the capital H and the capital Y.
hints.punctuation: Keep the comma and the ! inside the speech marks.

hints.other: Put 7 * 8 inside print() with no speech marks, so Python does the sum.
